notes.title: Notes for Tracker Users
notes.content:
If you are a user using Tracker, pay attention to this article.

The basic settings in Baseball Kings VR are One controller, That controller means bat.

If you want to use the tracker that is attached to the bat, turn off  the controller and then connect the tracker. After that, the tracker automatically means the bat.

If you have trouble using Tracker, please leave a response!
